security.csp: default-src 'self'; img-src 'self' data: blob: asset: http://asset.localhost; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; font-src 'self' data:; connect-src ipc: http://ipc.localhost; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'none'; form-action 'none'; frame-ancestors 'none'

bundle.longDescription: Magpie is a local-first bookmark manager for Windows: import from Chrome, Edge or HTML, organise links into colour-coded categories, search instantly, and get warned about unsafe sites before opening them. Optional AI categorisation and threat-intelligence lookups use your own API keys.
